notes.title: new DLC out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/939d9e42c6fd2d0004a49c6dcd2a5c6c7dc3929f.png[/img]

Hello everyone, we're thrilled to finally bring to you guys our newest DLC! Sticking to our original plan of a DLC a year, the DLC Storyteller is finished and ready to be played!

Serena meets an old friend and they decide to sit down and speak about the past, come with us to discover her old little secrets, including some really close relations with her younger sister and her boyfriend's father!

The DLC brings another 3 paths to be discovered, a brand new ending, many more gorgeous renders and a sizable expansion to the story!

[h3]SOUND[/h3]
Yes, it needs a separate section to be announced! We heard you all asking many times, so we officially have audio now! You'll notice the paths have custom songs to fit them, and now the game is devoid of silence (unless you mute it, and maybe there's an easter egg there).

[h3]ANIMATIONS[/h3]
Now for some bad news, we have animations ready and rendered, but the game engine is struggling to show them properly. We've contacted support but we have no ETA when the problems will be solved, it's unfortunately out of our hands. Whenever they get back to us with a solution we'll update you all.

[h3]Thank you all for the continued support you've given us, we wouldn't be bringing more Serena if not for you, so thank you for supporting this indie studio! We hope you'll enjoy the game we've made, see you soon![/h3]

notes.title: Midnight Ride - STEAM EDITION 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/4c2df938136714c419b7585cdf85851f2ca87cc1.png[/img]

[h1]Midnight Ride - STEAM EDITION 1.2[/h1]
Hello everyone!
We are thrilled to announce the latest and biggest game update so far.

For the past year we have been working on rebuilding the game from the ground up. Not only to make it possible to add the new DLC but also to add new features.

[h2]DLC Support[/h2]
Of course the biggest news is the added support for more content. The engine rebuild now allows us to easily add in more and more content. This includes the already announced paid DLC but also allows us to just add in more free content too! Just like that!

[h2]Workshop Integration[/h2]
Another big new feature is the integration into the Steam Workshop.
We will use this to allow all of you to add your own translations to share with world.
Pirate slang? Klingon? Elvish? If someone makes it, everyone can have it.

In a more traditional way the Workshop is meant to be used for all the languages that we as developers can't possibly add. But what we added is the support for more fonts that now cover almost all the languages officially supported by Steam. 
We can not support languages written from right to left which is a bigger technical challenge than just adding in fonts. Sorry about that, we will try to make that work.

We will release a detailed tutorial on how you can create translations for the game very soon.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
Due to a rewrite of most of the game code your [u]old save files will no longer work[/u] and won't show up in the game at all. But the [b]gallery[/b] and [b]roadmap[/b] process will get carried over to our new format and you should be able to just continue where you left off from the roadmap.

The game engine now finally supports the use of video files which means that we will make more use of it from now on. Yes, that means there will be [b]animations[/b] coming in the future!!

You also might have noticed that our achievements got new icons. In addition to the design change we also added plenty more achievements for the new DLC! 
But due to limitations from Steam, the DLC achievements are enabled for everyone, even if they don't own the DLC. Sorry about that.


Once again thank you all for the continued support you've given us, we'll see you soon!

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/8e273f9421059ba72fc7069a554e0c85dce7558d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Progress on the new DLC is going well![/h2]

As mentioned in a previous news post, the [b]DLC will contain 4 new story paths[/b] to explore. Both images shown here are from different story lines but don't worry, it won't all be female characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/697dfbc945403d9c01cad3394d398f7490a827f2.jpg[/img]


[h2]Planned Expansions[/h2]
The [b]new DLC[/b] will become available as part of a [b]Season Pass[/b] and as a standalone purchase. [b]The Season Pass will include 3 DLCs[/b] and will give you a discount on the individual prices of the DLCs. 

However pricing has not yet been decided but the [b]DLCs will cost less than the base game[/b] of course.


[h2]More Updates[/h2]

We decided to expand our portfolio due to popular demand!
The game will become available as [b]macOS and Linux builds[/b] in the near future and an Android build for tablets could also be an option if demand keeps up like this.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/9b63ab43010d06fe5dabf0663e6cf2c8a487deed.png[/img]

notes.title: More content and other news
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/27ab5b1dc6a0733c66ac3ea6278e3279f1e7f813.jpg[/img]

Hello wonderful people, we are glad that you are still with us because we have some exciting news to share!

[h2]More Content[/h2]
As previously mentioned, we are already working hard on adding more content to the game!

The first DLC will be called "Galactic Detour" and will feature 4 new paths to explore.

If you can't tell from the cover image, this will play in a sci-fi setting after Serena gets abducted on her way through the forest.



[h2]Trading Cards[/h2]
Trading Cards, Emotes and Backgrounds are finally here! 
We have added a total of 24 collectibles to the base game: 
[list]
[*] 6 cards
[*] 5 emotes
[*] 7 backgrounds
[*] 6 badges
[/list]

It was a popular request by many of you and Steam finally approved our designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/9b63ab43010d06fe5dabf0663e6cf2c8a487deed.png[/img]

notes.title: Into the Future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37101862/8a5dce2e04fd795f9ab6b8b288535c1d3e77dce5.png[/img]

[h2]THANK YOU[/h2]
First off: [b]A huge thank you[/b] to everyone who got this game!!
We are overwhelmed by how positive the overall response was in this first week.

There has been [b]a lot of feedback[/b] and we are working hard to fix and improve the things you found to be lacking.

This [b]small patch[/b] is a first round of quick fixes to repair critical flaws and add easy to implement changes but there will be bigger changes coming in the future.

You can check out this overview of changes on Trello:
https://trello.com/b/qIpdiSlC/midnight-ride-bug-tracker

[h2]Here are the patch notes for 1.0.3.0:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]F12 Screenshot:[/b]
The Steam Overlay Screenshot feature has been fixed and should work properly now.
[*] [b]Launch Issues:[/b]
Many reported launch problems with our (and others) Steam build but there is only so much we can do on our end. We flipped a few switches that hopefully help those who had launch issues so far.
[*] [b]UI Scaling issues:[/b]
We adjusted the way graphics setting changes are applied that should prevent you from scaling the UI beyond your displays capabilities.
[*] [b]UI Reset button:[/b]
In addition to the adjusted settings there is now a reset button at the [b]main menu, top left corner[/b], which will reset the UI back to stock settings. 
You can also press [b]the DEL key on your keyboard[/b] while in the main menu to reset the UI if you can't see the button.
[*] [b]Skip speed:[/b]
Apparently for some of you, the skipping was not fast enough so we enhanced the feature and you now can skip dialogue at a speed of up to 30 blocks a second! 
(This is just a stopgap fix until the more refined dialogue handling is implemented later)
[*] [b]Spacebar to advance:[/b]
Another addition is the Spacebar. It will do the exact same as the left mousebutton during dialogues. (Another stopgap fix until the remappable keys are implemented) 
[*] [b]more minor fixes:[/b]
- reduced the jittering of the "hovering" effect when positioning the mouse at the outmost border of a button
- fixed an exploit that lets the user input invalid values into the settings.ini, crashing the game.
- minor script and grammar/language errors
[/list]


[h2]And now? What's next?[/h2]
Well we are glad you asked! 
There have been a few requests for things that will need a bit more effort to implement from our side but [b]we are listening to you[/b] and will do our best to make things happen!

Among the most requested features was[b] Steam Tradingcards[/b] and we are glad to announce that they will be coming with the next big patch.

Another highly requested feature was [b]sound[/b]. We did not anticipate the passion people would have towards non-existing sound and that it would lead to that many negative reviews.
That said, we will look into this and add something in the future. Just please don't expect full voice over in a small 5$ project like ours!

[h2]So that's it?[/h2]
... you might be wondering and the answer is: [b]NO[/b]
We are planning to make the game [b]Steam Workshop[/b] compatible so it will be easier to add more language translations to it. That will require some effort from our side first and we are already working on it.

In addition we already laid plans for the first [b]content expansion[/b] to add more paths to the story. 
Just so you know this will be [b]paid DLC content[/b] so you won't get surprised in the future. 
But there is also plans for [b]free content additions[/b] down the line.


So there you have it, that's it from our side for now. 
Stay tuned for more and thank you again for this awesome first week!
